dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, ordering, mutual exclusion, help examples, and unchanged no-selection output are present; formatted output is not rejected when fields are selected.
evidence: product.diff: listOpts/flags and RunE mutual-exclusion hunk
product.diff: runList resolves selections before exporter.Write without a format conflict

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Name matching is case-insensitive and canonical names become headers; unknown-field candidates are actionable and sorted, but ambiguous matching IDs retain source order rather than deterministic sorting.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Resolution reuses ProjectItems field definitions, but no path fetches subsequent field-definition pages when Fields.PageInfo.HasNextPage is true.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go: ProjectItems requests firstFields=LimitMax and returns project.Fields
product.diff: runList resolves only project.Fields.Nodes; no pagination call added

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value types are rendered, with unknown types empty; raw text/date/title values are not normalized to remove carriage returns or replace newlines.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected canonical headers follow request order; rows map values by field ID and append an empty lookup result for missing values through the existing runList path.
evidence: product.diff: printResults values[value.ID()] and field.ID() lookup

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Selection errors return before exporter/table output, and the focused diff uses existing query types and resolver helpers without unrelated path changes.
evidence: product.diff: RunE mutual exclusion and runList error returns
product.diff: resolveSelectedFields error propagation before exporter.Write/printResults

criticalGaps: Selected fields are silently ignored with explicit formatted/JSON output instead of producing a flag-conflict error.
Field-definition pagination is absent, so fields beyond the first returned page cannot be selected.
Multiline field values are passed to the table unchanged.
Ambiguous field-ID diagnostics are not explicitly sorted.
